'''2007 Texas State Championship Philip Reyna LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Philip Reyna]] at [[2007 Texas State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Ref2-L-watchyourstep.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Krayt Step
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
